description_en: Queries the monitoring metrics of a resource
kebab_example: aliyun ebs describe-metric-data --metric-name disk_bps_percent --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeMetricData

parameters.help_en:
The name of the metric. Valid values:

disk_bps_percent
disk_iops_percent
disk_read_block_size
disk_read_bps
disk_read_iops
disk_write_block_size
disk_write_bps
disk_write_iops
parameters.help_zh:
指标名称。可选的值有：
   
disk_bps_percent
disk_iops_percent
disk_read_block_size
disk_read_bps
disk_read_iops
disk_write_block_size
disk_write_bps
disk_write_iops
parameters.name: metric_name

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query metric data. The start time can be up to 30 days before the current time. If you leave both the StartTime and EndTime parameters empty, the system queries the metrics for the most recent period. The time must be in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 获取指标数据的起始时间点。最远可选当前时刻过去30天内的时刻作为起始时间点。当StartTime和EndTime参数都为空时，默认查询最近一个period的监控指标。按照ISO 8601标准表示，并使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query metric data. The time cannot be later than the current time. The time must be in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 获取指标数据的结束时间点。不应大于当前时刻。按照ISO 8601标准表示，并使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The interval at which to query metric data. Unit: seconds. The default value is 5. Valid values:

5: 5-second precision. You can query data within a 12-hour time range.
10: 10-second precision. You can query data within a 24-hour time range.
60: 60-second precision. You can query data within a 7-day time range.
300: 300-second precision. You can query data within a 30-day time range.
600: 600-second precision. You can query data within a 30-day time range.
3600: 3600-second precision. You can query data within a 30-day time range
parameters.help_zh:
获取指标数据的间隔时间。单位：秒。默认值为5秒。可选的取值：

5：5s精度查询，可查询12小时时间长度
10：10s精度查询，可查询24小时时间长度
60：60s精度查询，可查询7天时间长度
300：300s精度查询，可查询30天时间长度
600：600s精度查询，可查询30天时间长度
3600：3600s精度查询，可查询30天时间长度
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
A map of dimensions in the JSON format. The map specifies the dimensions to query. The following keys are supported:

DiskId: The disk name, such as d-xxx.
DeviceType: The disk category. \`system\` indicates a system disk and \`data\` indicates a data disk.
DeviceCategory: The disk type, such as cloud_essd.
EcsInstanceId: The name of the ECS instance to which the disk is attached, such as i-xxx.
Azone: The zone, such as cn-hangzhou-a.

The returned results are the intersection of all specified dimension-based filter conditions
parameters.help_zh:
维度Map，JSON格式，表示查询的维度，当前可选的键为：
DiskId：云盘名，例如d-xxx。
DeviceType：云盘种类，system表示系统盘，data表示数据盘。
DeviceCategory：云盘类型，例如cloud_essd。
EcsInstanceId：所在的ECS实例名，例如i-xxx。
Azone：可用区，例如cn-hangzhou-a。

返回结果取所有维度筛选条件的交集
parameters.name: dimensions

parameters.help_en:
The method for aggregating data over time. Valid values:

SUM_OVER_TIME
COUNT_OVER_TIME
AVG_OVER_TIME
MAX_OVER_TIME
MIN_OVER_TIME
SUM_OVER_TIME_LCRO: The sum of values in a left-closed, right-open interval.
AVG_OVER_TIME_LCRO: The average of values in a left-closed, right-open interval.
SUM_OVER_TIME_LORC: The sum of values in a left-open, right-closed interval.
AVG_OVER_TIME_LORC: The average of values in a left-open, right-closed interval
parameters.help_zh:
时间维度聚合方式。可选的值有：

SUM_OVER_TIME
COUNT_OVER_TIME
AVG_OVER_TIME
MAX_OVER_TIME
MIN_OVER_TIME
SUM_OVER_TIME_LCRO：左闭右开区间求总和
AVG_OVER_TIME_LCRO：左闭右开区间求均值
SUM_OVER_TIME_LORC：左开右闭区间求总和
AVG_OVER_TIME_LORC：左开右闭区间求均值
parameters.name: aggre_ops

parameters.help_en:
The method for aggregating data across different lines. Valid values:

NON: No aggregation is performed.
SUM: The sum of values.
AVG: The average of values.
COUNT: The number of values.
MAX: The maximum value.
MIN: The minimum value
parameters.help_zh:
线之间的聚合方式。可选的值有：
NON：不做聚合
SUM：求和
AVG：求均值
COUNT：计数
MAX：求最大值
MIN：求最小值
parameters.name: aggre_over_line_ops

parameters.help_en: A list of fields for grouping and aggregation
parameters.help_zh: 用于分组聚合的字段列表
parameters.name: group_by_labels

DataList.description_en: A collection of monitoring data for the disk

Datapoints.description_en: A list of monitoring data. The list contains a series of consecutive second-level timestamps and the corresponding metric values
Datapoints.description_zh: 监控数据列表，一系列连续的秒级时间戳和查询的指标对应时刻的值的列表

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of data entries returned
